about.title: Amber Miro Heinbockel | Design Leader, Mentor & AI UX Specialist
about.description: Amber Miro Heinbockel is an AI-focused UX design leader helping teams create usable, trustworthy intelligent systems. Insights on human-AI collaboration, product strategy, and career mentorship.

sections.heading: Design leader. Systems thinker. Mentor. Artist.
My Story.
paras: I’ve spent my career designing how people move through complex systems — from early agency days and startups to Google’s AI & Compute Enablement team. I learned quickly that the impact of design isn’t about the tools we use. It’s about creating clarity in places where people feel overwhelmed or unsure.

I’ve always believed that intelligent systems should enhance human judgment, not override it. That belief shaped the teams I’ve built, the systems I’ve led, and the way I help designers and leaders navigate change.
Head of Design, ACE UX - Google

sections.heading: Design in Practice
paras: A look at the product spaces, decisions, and frameworks I’ve shaped across AI, developer experience, and emerging technologies. From vision and strategy to hands-on collaboration with research, PM, and engineering — here’s how I guide complex systems toward clarity.

sections.heading: Deploy AI, Anywhere
paras: I led the design of Google’s AI Edge Gallery, a platform that helps developers discover, evaluate, and deploy on-device ML models with clarity and confidence. From model selection to performance insights, Edge Gallery brings structure to an emerging ecosystem that’s historically been fragmented and opaque.
Model Discovery
A curated, transparent way to explore models optimized for on-device performance across use cases, hardware targets, and constraints.
Seamless Integration
Structured documentation, sample apps, and code paths that shorten the gap between choosing a model and shipping it into production.
Offline & Edge Ready
Support for models built to run reliably on-device — even without connectivity — unlocking new experiences for mobile, IoT, and embedded products.
Media

sections.heading: AI Assistant for WearOS
paras: I helped shape the next-generation Assistant experience on WearOS — designing how intelligent, on-device AI shows up on the smallest, fastest surface we have: the wrist.From voice interactions to proactive suggestions, my work focused on making the Assistant feel helpful, calm, and deeply integrated into everyday moments.
Faster, Hands-Free Interactions
Context-Aware Responses
Glanceable Intelligence
A More Human Voice

sections.heading: Build, edit, and share AI mini-apps using natural language
paras: Opal is a reminder that creating with AI shouldn’t feel technical — it should feel imaginative. My job was to support the team building it: clearing space, offering direction when needed, and helping translate a big idea into something creators can actually use.

sections.heading: The Work Beneath the Work
paras: Design leadership often happens offstage.
It’s the listening, the clearing of obstacles, the quiet support that lets teams do their best work — long before anything ships.

This deck captures some of that early thinking — the frameworks, questions, and narrative threads I use to guide teams toward clarity. Not as deliverables, but as a way of working: inviting momentum, reducing friction, and helping people move together with purpose.

mentor.title: Amber Miro Heinbockel | Design Leader, Mentor & AI UX Specialist
mentor.description: Personal, honest mentorship for designers seeking clarity in their careers. Amber helps people think through decisions, build confidence, and develop the skills needed to design in an AI-driven world.

sections.heading: Clarity for designers in the age of AI
paras: I mentor designers who are navigating big decisions: career moves, AI shifts, leadership growth, and the messy middle of product work. If you’re looking for honest feedback, practical frameworks, and a little encouragement, you’re in the right place.
Currently volunteering mentorship time on ADP List

sections.heading: Mentorship matters
paras: If I look back at the arc of my career, the turning points were almost always sparked, supported or challenged by someone who chose to mentor me. Not with grand gestures — just quiet clarity. A conversation that reframed a problem, a question I hadn’t thought to ask, a reminder that my work mattered.

The mentors who shaped me didn’t just teach me how to design products — they taught me how to design a life. How to navigate uncertainty with some grace, how to advocate for myself, how to lead with heart, and how to stay creative even under pressure. Their influence shows up not only in my work as a design leader, but in my art practice as well — the confidence to explore, to take risks, to create without permission.

Every designer needs someone in their corner. I mentor because I’ve been on the other side of uncertainty, and I know how much a single honest conversation can change your direction. This is how I give that moment back.

sections.heading: A joyful counterweight to the technical world of AI & design.
paras: My fine art practice is where I come back to color, intuition, and play.

sections.heading: My Artist Story.
paras: I paint under the name Amber Miro — Miro is my middle name, after the painter Joan Miró, my parents know i was destined to be a creative from the start.. My art practice draws from that same spirit for Joan Miró in vibrancy and experimentation, translated through florals, landscapes, and expressive abstract work.

I hope my work brings the same joy to you that it brings to me while I’m making it.I’ve always believed that intelligent systems should enhance human judgment, not override it. That belief shaped the teams I’ve built, the systems I’ve led, and the way I help designers and leaders navigate change.

sections.heading: Amber Miro Art
paras: I’m inspired by Nature, travel, wild blooms, and the soft shifts of light . My style leans toward bold palettes and lively, energetic marks — pieces meant to feel warm, alive, and quietly celebratory, bringing joy to the spaces we live in.
Whether you’re here get to know me or explore my new collections. I hope you'll explore
